title: Job Application and CV / Maalaqaa Ajajaa fi Seenaa Ka'aa
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffaa, mana hidha ‘I have 25 years’ kana ‘I am a Tourism graduate’ jedhani; laikin akkas jedhamu godhatee gara qorataa keessatti walitti dhaabbata. Akakaas, ‘experience’ (hanga ‘experiences’ hin jiru) fi adjiificha gara qindeessaa keessatti barbaachisaa qabaa fi suuraa afaan Ingiliffaatti deebii akkas jedhamu godhatee wajjin tokkoo ta’ee barbaachisa. ‘Me dedico a’ akkas godheen ‘I dedicate myself to’ hin jedhi; ‘I work as’ kana ‘I am responsible for’ jedhi.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa gara dhaabbata ajajaa keessatti walitti dhaabbata: 1) Ajajaa kee hin baasu, ‘I work as a...’ (Mana ajajaa...) kana ‘I am responsible for...’ (Mana ajajaa keessatti haasa’aa ta’ee). 2) Ajajaa du’aa keessatti, ‘used to’ kana qoosaa du’aa keessaa qabu: ‘I used to work at...’ / ‘I worked at...’. 3) Qofa ‘have’ umrii fi haala qindeessaa hin kennamu: ‘I have five years of experience’. 4) Adjiificha gara qindeessaa keessatti barbaachisa: ‘I have strong communication skills’. 5) ‘In’ sektataa (‘experience in hospitality’), ‘at’ gara baafacha (‘at a hotel’), fi ‘as’ gara deebii (‘as a manager’) qabu. 6) Seenaa ka’aa keessatti, qorataa guutan qabaa barbaachisa, mana qorataa guutan qabaa hin qaba.

title: Discussing current events / Maaliwwan dhaabbata fi hojiiwwan ajajaa qabanna.
bridge: Afaan Oromo, guyyaa lamaa fi guyyaa du’aa dhaabbata qabanna kana malee, Afaan Ingiliffii guyyaa lamaa fi guyyaa du’aa dhaabbata qabanna kan itti himanamanii wajjin tokko tokko qabanna. Kana malees, guyyaa lamaa fi guyyaa du’aa dhaabbata qabanna kan itti himanamanii wajjin tokko tokko qabanna. Guyyaa lamaa fi guyyaa du’aa dhaabbata qabanna kan itti himanamanii wajjin tokko tokko qabanna.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffii B1 dhaabbata qabanna: 1. Guyyaa lamaa (have/has + participio) dhaabbata ajajaa qabanna: 'Scientists have discovered a new planet.' 2. Guyyaa du’aa dhaabbata ajajaa qabanna: 'They announced the result yesterday.' 3. Guyyaa lamaa fi guyyaa du’aa dhaabbata qabanna: 'The government is debating the new law.' 4. Dhaabbata qabanna: 'I think', 'In my opinion', 'I believe'. 5. Vocabulario: 'headline', 'article', 'report', 'according to', 'latest', 'issue'.

title: Cultural Differences and Misunderstandings / Faayidaa biloo qabduu fi suuraa amalaa
bridge: Afaan Oromo, dukkaa qabduu fi suuraa amalaa hinka’an haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee, afaan Ingiliffaa tokko tokko qofa hin taane. Akakaa ‘I think…’ (Ani beektu) kana malee ‘Maybe…’ (Maaliif) jechuun haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane. Akakaa ‘Do you mean…?’ (Maaliif jechuu kan hin beektu?) jechuun suuraa amalaa haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane. Suuraa amalaa haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane, akakaa ‘What do you mean?’ (Jechuu kan hin beektu?) jechuun haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane. Akakaa ‘I misunderstood’ (Ani beektu) jechuun haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffaa B1 dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane, haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane: 1) Galmeessee tokko tokko: ‘Could you explain that?’ (Maaliif jechuu kan hin beektu?) jechuun ‘Explain that’ (Jechuu kan hin beektu). 2) Haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane: ‘I think’, ‘I feel’, ‘I guess’ jechuun haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane. 3) Galmeessee tokko tokko: ‘Do you mean…?’, ‘Are you saying…?’ jechuun haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane. 4) Akakaa ‘I misunderstood’ (Ani beektu) jechuun haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane. ‘To be right’ (Haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane) jechuun ‘to have reason’ (Haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane) hin jiru. ‘To need’ (Haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane) jechuun ‘to make lack’ (Haala dhaabbataa ta’ee malee qofa hin taane) hin jiru.

title: Discussing Environmental Topics / Gosaa dhiheessan baanaa baasiigaa
bridge: Afaan Oromo, hojiiwwan sirrii dhiheessan baanaa baasiigaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban, barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban ('barbaachisu') kana barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban ('barbaachisu') hin kennan. Afaan Ingiliffaa, barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban ('we pollute') barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban ('we are polluting') hin kennan. Afaan Ingiliffaa, hojiiwwan sirrii dhiheessan baanaa baasiigaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban ('We are going to reduce waste'), 'be going to' kana barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban hin kennan. Afaan Oromo, 'should' hojiiwwan sirrii dhiheessan baanaa baasiigaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban ('deberíamos').
rule: Gosaa dhiheessan baanaa baasiigaa afaan Ingiliffaa B1, barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban: 1) Barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban (hojiiwwan sirrii: 'The planet is warming' – barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban hojiiwwan sirrii; hojiiwwan sirrii: 'Climate change affects everyone'), 2) Barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban (hojiiwwan sirrii: 'Forests are disappearing'), 3) 'be going to' + barbaachisaa (hojiiwwan sirrii: 'We are going to install solar panels'), ja 4) 'should' + barbaachisaa (hojiiwwan sirrii: 'You should recycle more'). Afaan Ingiliffaa, barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban '-s' hin kennan (he/she/it). 'There is/are' (hay), 'there is' hin kennan, 'there are' hin kennan. 'Because', 'so', 'therefore' hojiiwwan sirrii hin kennan. Adjectives hin kennan ('renewable energy', hin kennan 'energy renewable').

title: Talking About Technology and Social Media / Teknoloojii fi Miidiyaa Ibsuu Wallaafa
bridge: Afaan Oromo, malee baafacha godhatee hunda argachuu fi hojiiwwan godhachuu barbaachisa (fakkeenya ‘guyyaa kan hin amanuu keessanii walqabsaa jiraachuu’ jedhu), Afaan Ingiliffii gara godhatee fi hojiiwwan godhachuu irra deebi’anii jira. Teknoloojii tokko tokko wallaafachuu akkasumas, Afaan Oromo essee ‘kan na qabnu qixxi’ jechuudhaan, Afaan Ingiliffi ‘I have to click’ jechuudhaan kan ta’ee jira. Phrasal verbs (fakkeenya ‘log in’, ‘sign up’) kan Afaan Oromo irra deebi’anii jiru malee qabnuuf barbaadu.
rule: Teknoloojii fi miidiyaa ibsuu wallaafachuu Afaan Ingiliffii B1 sirrii, haa akkan godha: 1) Godhatee hunda argachuu fi hojiiwwan godhachuu (I check my phone every morning). 2) Hojiiwwan godhachuu (I am scrolling through Instagram right now). 3) Verbs modals: can, should, must (You should update your password). 4) Phrasal verbs: log in, log out, sign up, turn on, turn off, set up. 5) ‘Like’ fi ‘share’ (I like the post, She shared the video). ‘Social media’ irraa malees uumaa kennuuf dhiisuu miti. ‘Have’ kan qabnuuf barbaadu (I have a new phone).

title: Talking about Education and Studying Abroad / Barra biraa fi barumsaa qooda
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti, israa irra jiruuf malee mootummaa qooda 'I am studying' jedhanii argachuu danda'a. Akakaasisu, 'I have 20 years' hin jaalatu; 'I am 20 years old' jedhi. Barra biraa keessatti, ibsa biraa fi qooda biraa qajeelfama kennamuu hin qabnu ('I study mathematics'), Afaan Oromoo keessattis kennamuu qabnu ('Barra biraa qaba'). Kana malee, kun immoo akkan hin qabnu.
rule: Barra biraa fi barumsaa qooda afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti B1 sirrii wajjin, haa akkan godhi: 1. Mootummoota ajjeechaa fi bara dhaabbataa ('I study every day'). 2. Israa irra jiruuf malee mootummaa qooda ('I am studying for my exam') fi israa irra jiruuf malee mootummaa qooda ('I am going to England next month'). 3. 'Going to' israa irra jiruuf malee mootummaa qooda ('I'm going to apply for a scholarship'). 4. 'Will' israa irra jiruuf malee mootummaa qooda ('I think it will be a great experience'). 5. Qajeelfama 'can', 'must', 'should' qabduudha, bara dhaabbataa fi haala dhaabbataa ('You should apply early'). 6. Preposishan: 'study at a university', 'apply for a course', 'major in' (qajeelfama), 'take an exam'. 7. Ibsa biraa fi qooda biraa qajeelfama kennamuu hin qabnu ('I like history'). 8. 'Abroad' (qooda) preposishan hin jiru, 'to study abroad' ama 'study abroad' maleesuma ama ibsa biraa qabu.

title: Talking about Past Trips and Travel Experiences / Dhaabbataa hojii fi dhaga’uuwwan dheeraa
bridge: Afaan Oromo, dhaabbataa hojii fi dhaga’uuwwan dheeraa qajeelfama kana malee wanti harkisaa’e akkasumas gocha gochaatti godhi. Afaan Ingilizii, kun godhuu miti: present perfect (have + participle) dhaabbataa hojii fi dhaga’uuwwan dheeraa akkasii tokko ilaalchisee malees, past simple (viajé) hojiin dheeraa akkasii tokko ilaalchisee malees. Akkasumas, afaan Oromo, ‘he viajado’ jechuun ‘viajé’ jechuunis akkasumas godhi. Afaan Ingilizii, kun godhuu miti: present perfect (have + participle) dhaabbataa hojii fi dhaga’uuwwan dheeraa akkasii tokko ilaalchisee malees, past simple (viajé) hojiin dheeraa akkasii tokko ilaalchisee malees. Akkasumas, afaan Oromo, ‘he viajado’ jechuun ‘viajé’ jechuunis akkasumas godhi.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii, dhaabbataa hojii fi dhaga’uuwwan dheeraa barumsaa B1, lamaan hamma tokenne efannoon: present perfect (have/has + past participle) fi past simple (verbo en pasado). Present perfect: 1) dhaabbataa hojii fi dhaga’uuwwan dheeraa akkasii tokko ilaalchisee malees (I have visited Paris), 2) adverbbii ‘ever’, ‘never’, ‘already’, ‘yet’ (Have you ever been to Japan?), 3) hojiin dheeraa akkasii tokko ilaalchisee malees (I have lived here for three years). Past simple: 1) hojiin dheeraa akkasii tokko ilaalchisee malees (I visited Paris last summer), 2) adverbbii ‘yesterday’, ‘in 2019’, ‘last week’, ‘when I was a child’. Verbs irregular: go-went-gone, see-saw-seen, eat-ate-eaten, take-took-taken, fly-flew-flown, ride-rode-ridden, drive-drove-driven, stay-stayed-stayed (regular). Present perfect: Have/Has + sujeto + participio? (Have you ever flown first class?). Respuestas cortas: Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Past simple: Did + sujeto + verbo base? (Did you go to the beach?). Respuestas cortas: Yes, I did / No, I didn't. 'Ever' fi 'never' present perfect, past simple: 'I have never been to Mexico' (no 'I never went to Mexico'). 'Since' hojiin dheeraa akkasii tokko ilaalchisee malees (I have visited Spain since 2018 - incorrecto si no continúa), 'since' hojiin dheeraa akkasii tokko ilaalchisee malees (I have been in Spain since 2018). Adjectives (amazing, terrible, wonderful, boring) 'was/were' past simple dhaabbataa hojii fi dhaga’uuwwan dheeraa.

title: Talking about habits and routines / Afaan Ingilizii keessatti baasaa fi baasaa qabduu qabduu hordofu
bridge: Afaan Oromo keessatti, baasaa fi baasaa qabduu qabduu hordofu akkasumas Afaan Ingilizii keessatti dhufan isaanii argachuu danda'a. Laakin, ayyaanaa lamaan qaba. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, dhufaa 'do/does' akkasumas 'no' hin jiru; garuu, Afaan Oromo keessatti 'no' akkasumas qophii sadarkaa hin jiru. Adabbiwwan ajajeebii (always, usually, etc.) Afaan Ingilizii keessatti dhugee fuulaa deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii akkasumas 'to be' deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata. Akkasumas, qophii sadarkaa (he/she/it) Afaan Ingilizii keessatti 's' deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata, kanarraa Afaan Oromo keessatti hin jiru.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti baasaa fi baasaa qabduu qabduu hordofu akkasumas dhufan isaanii argachuu danda'a. Qophii sadarkaa (he, she, it) keessatti, '-s' akkasumas '-es' dhugee fuulaa deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata (e.g., 'works', 'goes'). Akkasumas, 'do not' (don't) akkasumas 'does not' (doesn't) + dhugee fuulaa deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata. Akkasumas, 'do' akkasumas 'does' qabduu qabduu hordofu akkasumas dhugee fuulaa deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata. Adabbiwwan ajajeebii (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) Afaan Ingilizii keessatti: (1) dhugee fuulaa deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii akkasumas (I always drink coffee), (2) 'to be' deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata (He is always late), akkasumas (3) ajajni akkasumas dhugee fuulaa deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata (Do you often exercise?). Akkasumas, 'have' dhugee fuulaa deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata, 'have/has' deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata (I have breakfast at 8). 'Go' akkasumas 'do' dhugee fuulaa deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata, qophii sadarkaa 'goes' akkasumas 'does' deebi'aa ta'e jedhanii dhaabbata.

title: Making Plans and Invitations / Dhaabbata fi Suufannoo Godhamuu
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, dhaabbata fi suufannoo godhamuuf adabbi ‘would you like to...?’ kana ‘how about...?’ hin qabne dubbiiwwan akkasuma hin jiru. Akkasumas, ‘hang out’ jedhanii fidalattii suuraa walitti dhiisuu akkaan ta’ee qajeelfama isaaniif kennamu. Afaan Ingilizii dhaabbata du’aa keessatti aadaa ta’uu (I'm meeting) kan ta’e afaan Isbaanichii gara qolee isaa hin ta’in (Quedo) malee qabna.
rule: Suufannoo godhamuuf: ‘Would you like to + fiilichi?’ (sadarkaa) kana ‘Do you want to + fiilichi?’ (akkaan ta’ee) qabna. Dhaabbata godhamuuf: ‘How about + gerund?’ kana ‘What about + gerund?’. Duubnee godhamuuf: ‘Sure’, ‘Sounds good’, ‘I'd love to’. Duubnee hin godhamuuf: ‘I'm afraid I can't’, ‘Sorry, I have other plans’. Dhaabbata du’aa keessatti, aadaa ta’uu (I'm meeting my friends tomorrow) kana ‘going to’ (I'm going to visit my sister) qabna. Fiilaa ‘hang out’ jecha irraa jaalalaa akkaan ta’ee isaaniitiif kennamu. ‘¿Quedamos?’ jedhaniin ‘Are we staying?’ hin godhachuu qabna; ‘Shall we meet?’ kana ‘Let's meet up’ jechuu isaanii wajjin tokko tokkooti.

title: Giving a short presentation / Gaaffii sirrii qabanii godhatee
bridge: Afaan Espaanii keessatti, mana dhiiseef barbaachisaa dubbatan qabuuf jechuudhaan tokko tokkoon barbaachisaa hojjetan qabannee jira. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, macaafniif godhamuuf, barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban qindeessan qaban jechuudhaan qorataa hojjetan qabanii fi qorataa sirrii qaban amala qaban. Haaroomni dubbii keessatti, Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘going to’ kana ‘will’ jechuun hojjetaa sirrii qabanii hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban. Afaan Espaanii keessatti, hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, ‘firstly’, ‘in addition’, ‘to sum up’ jechuun hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban. Afaan Espaanii keessatti, ‘en primer lugar’, ‘además’, ‘para resumir’ jechuun hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti gaaffii sirrii qabanii godhatee, kun qorataa hojjetan qabanii fi qorataa sirrii qaban amala qaban: 1) Salaamni fi macaafniif godhamuuf (e.g., 'Good morning, I'm going to talk about...'), 2) Hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan qorataa hojjetan qabanii fi qorataa sirrii qaban amala qaban (firstly, secondly, in addition, however), 3) Qorataa hojjetan qabanii fi qorataa sirrii qaban amala qaban (to conclude, in summary). Hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan ‘going to’ kana ‘will’ jechuun hojjetaa sirrii qabanii hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban. Qorataa hojjetan qabanii fi qorataa sirrii qaban amala qaban, ‘Let me start by...’, ‘Moving on to...’, ‘To wrap up...’ jechuun hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban.

concept_examples.text: Good morning, today I'm going to talk about the importance of recycling.
concept_examples.translation: Guyyaa wajjin, inni qajeelfamni gosaa’in hojii irra deebi’ee keessatti waan godhatama.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ təˈdeɪ aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə tɔːk əˈbaʊt ði ɪmˈpɔːrtəns əv rɪˈsaɪklɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: Firstly, recycling helps reduce waste in our cities.
concept_examples.translation: Hundumaa, gosaa’in hojii irra deebi’ee keessatti qajeelfamni gosaa’in hojii irra deebi’ee keessatti waan godhatama.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈfɜːrstli ˈriːsaɪklɪŋ helps rɪˈduːs weɪst ɪn aʊər ˈsɪtiz/

concept_examples.text: In addition, it saves energy and natural resources.
concept_examples.translation: Isaani wajjin, qajeelfamni gosaa’in hojii irra deebi’ee keessatti qajeelfamni gosaa’in hojii irra deebi’ee keessatti waan godhatama.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn əˈdɪʃən ɪt seɪvz ˈenərdʒi ənd ˈnætʃrəl ˈriːsɔːrsɪz/

concept_examples.text: To conclude, we all should recycle more to protect the planet.
concept_examples.translation: Guyyaa dhuma, qajeelfamni gosaa’in hojii irra deebi’ee keessatti qajeelfamni gosaa’in hojii irra deebi’ee keessatti waan godhatama.
concept_examples.phonetic: /tə kənˈkluːd wi ɔːl ʃʊd rɪˈsaɪkl mɔːr tə prəˈtekt ðə ˈplænɪt/

common_error.wrong: Good morning, I going to talk about the recycling.
common_error.correct: Good morning, I'm going to talk about recycling.
common_error.correct_alt: Good morning, I'm going to talk about the importance of recycling.
common_error.explanation: Dhiifama tokko ‘be going to’ jechuun hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban. Afaan Espaanii keessatti, ‘voy a hablar’ jechuun hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, ‘am/is/are’ jechuun hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban. ‘The’ jechuun hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban. ‘Am/is/are’ jechuun hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban jechuudhaan hojjetaa barbaachisaa hojjetan qaban amala qaban.
